query:
SELECT 
  m.sponsorId,
  m.attendeeNumber,
  m.timeSlot,
  COUNT(*) as meetingCount,
  s.companyName,
  GROUP_CONCAT(m.attendeeId ORDER BY m.id SEPARATOR ' | ') as attendeeIds,
  GROUP_CONCAT(m.id ORDER BY m.id SEPARATOR ' | ') as meetingIds
FROM meetings m
LEFT JOIN sponsors s ON m.sponsorId = s.id
GROUP BY m.sponsorId, m.attendeeNumber, m.timeSlot
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
ORDER BY meetingCount DESC;
